definition: PolyAnalyst is a data science software platform developed by Megaputer Intelligence that provides an environment for text mining, data mining, machine learning, and predictive analytics.
details: It is used by Megaputer to build tools with applications to health care, business management, insurance, and other industries. PolyAnalyst has also been used for COVID-19 forecasting and scientific research.

explainer.lead: PolyAnalyst is a data science platform from Megaputer Intelligence covering text mining, data mining, machine learning, and predictive analytics. It is used to build tools for healthcare, business management, and insurance.

tiers.eli5: It's a workbench where analysts clean data, search text, and build prediction models in one place.
tiers.practitioner: Teams use it for text and predictive analytics in regulated industries. A pitfall is treating its built-in models as turnkey without validating them on domain data.
tiers.paperLevel: It is an integrated environment combining text mining, data mining, machine learning, and predictive analytics in one platform. Its scope is broad rather than defined by a single algorithm or formal limit.

explainer.example: PolyAnalyst has been used for COVID-19 forecasting and other scientific research.
